title: 第7章 世上真有神仙第8章 两个亿
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 十位将士从家里返回，他们眼眶红了，都落过泪。
昨天他们一个个表情哀伤中透着绝望。
而今全充满活力，哪怕红着眼眶，嘴是裂开笑着。
他们都在等叶苜苜送水过来！
此时，将军府门口闹哄哄的，有流民在闹事。
战承胤让田秦出去看看。
他们出去没多久，围聚闹事的人越来越多，声音大到府内都听的一清二楚。
战承胤起身，刚走到门口，只听见众人叫喊：“求将军开仓放粮！”
“将军，您府上明明有米，为何要私藏？您难道眼睁睁看着镇关百姓活活饿死？”
“将军，求您救救百姓们吧，我们不想被饿死！”
将军府门前，闹事的百姓已有两百人！
为首是一名叫刘四的男子，长相下三白眼，颧骨突出。
他和昨日交换孩子的父亲相识，以前都是地痞流氓。
他见战承胤走出将军府，大声起哄叫嚷：“将军出来了，大家求他放粮，能不能活下去，咱们全看将军了！”
战承胤双目阴沉看向闹事众人。
“将军府没有米，速速离开！”
刘四嘿嘿笑道：“将军，你说没米就没米？”
他从角落拉出打鼻青脸肿的老妇人，三岁小女孩被她死死护在怀里。
老人家满脸是血，浑浊双眼泛着泪光，愧对将军，不敢看他。
刘四从口袋里掏出包饭团的黄纸，上面沾的白米粒~
饿昏的百姓看见几粒饭，全都吞咽口水。
这可是白米饭啊！
哪怕就几粒，谁不想吃？
没干旱前，他们都不舍得买精米，何况现在到处闹饥荒！
“将军，你将饭团给这老不死的饭吃，为什么不给我们，你明明就有粮。”
“你是想饿死全城的百姓吗？”
刘四话音一落，所有百姓都在呐喊，“请将军开仓放粮！”
“请将军开仓放粮……”
“将军，给我们一条活路吧！”
几百人全部跪下，请求战承胤放粮。
可，他也没有粮。
早上几百袋面食，要优先供应给军营，否则最后200匹战马不保！
这件事，他绝不能松口！
刘四见战承胤无动于衷，蓦地把被打面目全非的漾儿和他娘，摔到战承胤面前。
他恶狠狠道：“说，是不是将军给你们的饭团？饭团里包肉！”
听见饭团有肉，很多人狠狠咽下口水。
妇人被打的已奄奄一息，死不松口。
漾儿护住母亲，对刘四大骂：“你伙同爹爹，吃了我弟弟和妹妹，连我娘都不放过，我要杀了你！”
content_en:
Ten soldiers returned from home, their eyes were red and they all shed tears.
Yesterday, all of them had sad and despairing expressions.
Now he is full of energy, even if his eyes are red and his mouth is smiling.
They are all waiting for Clover Leaf to bring water!
At this time, there was a lot of noise at the entrance of the General's Mansion, as refugees were making trouble.
Zhan Chengyin asked Tian Qin to go out and take a look.
Not long after they left, more and more people gathered around to make trouble, and the noise was so loud that it could be heard clearly throughout the house.
Zhan Chengyin got up and just walked to the door when he heard everyone shouting: "Please general, please open the warehouse to put food in!"
"General, you obviously have rice in your house, why do you hide it secretly? Are you just watching the people in Zhenguan starve to death?"
"General, please save the people, we don't want to starve to death!"
There were already two hundred people making trouble in front of the General's Mansion!
The leader was a man named Liu Si, who had three white eyes and prominent cheekbones.
He met the father who exchanged children yesterday. They were both gangsters in the past.
When he saw Zhan Chengyin walking out of the general's mansion, he shouted loudly: "The general is coming out. Everyone begs him for food. Whether we can survive or not, it all depends on the general!"
Zhan Chengyin looked at the troublemakers with gloomy eyes.
"There is no rice in the General's Mansion, leave quickly!"
Liu Si chuckled and said: "General, you said there is no rice if there is no rice?"
He pulled out the old woman with a bruised nose and face from the corner, and the three-year-old girl was tightly protected in her arms.
The old man's face was covered with blood, and his cloudy eyes were filled with tears. He was ashamed to face the general and did not dare to look at him.
Liu Si took out the yellow paper wrapping the rice balls from his pocket, with white rice grains stained on it~
The hungry people all swallowed their saliva when they saw a few grains of rice.
This is white rice!
Even if it’s just a few pills, who wouldn’t want to eat it?
Before the drought, they were reluctant to buy polished rice, let alone now that there is famine everywhere!
"General, you give the rice balls to this old immortal. Why don't you give them to us? You obviously have food."
"Do you want to starve the entire city to death?"
As soon as Liu Si finished speaking, all the people shouted, "Please general, please open the granary to release grain!"
"Please ask the general to open a warehouse to store grain..."
"General, give us a way to survive!"
Hundreds of people all knelt down and begged Zhan Chengyin for food.
However, he also has no food.
Hundreds of bags of pasta in the morning must be supplied to the military camp first, otherwise the last 200 horses will not be guaranteed!
He must not let go of this matter!
Seeing that Zhan Chengyin was indifferent, Liu Si suddenly threw Yang'er and his mother, who were beaten beyond recognition, in front of Zhan Chengyin.
He said fiercely: "Tell me, are these the rice balls that the general gave you? The rice balls are filled with meat!"
Many people swallowed hard when they heard that the rice balls contained meat.
The woman was beaten to the point of dying and refused to let go.
Yang'er protected her mother and cursed Liu Si: "You teamed up with dad to eat my brother and sister, and you didn't even let my mother go. I'm going to kill you!"
title_en: Chapter 7 There really are gods in the world Chapter 8 Two hundred million
